whatThisIs: The AAP website hosts a wealth of information on formula feeding, teething and tooth care, pediatric specialists, and at-home safety and prevention, to name a few topics. This site offers educational information and developmental benchmarks for children, parents, and families from the prenatal stage to early adulthood.
whoItHelps: Parents and families looking for resources on bottle feeding and infant nutrition
Parents and families who want to learn what pediatric specialists are and how they might help their child
Parents and families looking for developmental benchmarks for children reaching preschool age
Parents and families looking for ways to introduce books to children, tips on school readiness, and other tools to support and assess their child's mental, physical, and emotional growth
whatToKnow: This website is designed to increase health literacy. Subject matter experts create and review its content in line with AAP policies and guidelines. The website primarily features articles and charts, and the AAP editorial staff regularly reviews and updates all content to provide up-to-date health information.
name: HealthyChildren - American Academy of Pediatrics
